[Back to all emotions](why-we-have-emotions.qmd)

Envy is about wanting something that someone else has.

## It can give us the urge to

- compare;
- compete; or
- get what someone else has.

## It may be telling us

- someone has something we want;
- a goal matters to us; or
- we feel behind.

## What can help

1. Name what you want.
2. Turn comparison into a healthy goal.
3. Learn from others.
4. Notice your own progress and what you already have.

## Design connection

Gold, classic type, and achievement symbols can suggest status and aspiration.

**Examples:** Rolex, Jordan, and Coach.
